messages.text: Hello! So, funny story: I ordered these pillow covers thinking they'd match my sofa, and my cat immediately decided one of them was her new bed. Anyway, I sent the pillow cover back, the one that didn't work. Could you refund it? Also, is it normal that colours look different in person?

Happy to help! The shop’s records show both the mustard and teal pillow covers were received back. Which would you like refunded? (refund-policy/v2/return)

Colours can look different in person because of lighting and screen settings. If you’d like a closer review of the colour difference, I can offer help from a staff member.
